summary.text: Susannah Whipps is an unenrolled state representative from Athol who has represented the 2nd Franklin District since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is co-owner of Whipps, Inc., a family business that designs and manufactures equipment for the water and wastewater industry, and a former Athol selectman.

paragraphs.text: Whipps is a seventh-generation Athol resident who attended Athol schools and colleges in Rhode Island and Massachusetts.
She earned an associate degree in culinary arts from Johnson & Wales University and a bachelor's degree in interdisciplinary studies from Fitchburg State University.
By age 25 she had opened two restaurants, and in 2000 she joined her parents at the family business, Whipps, Inc.
Whipps was first elected to the Athol Board of Selectmen in 2005 and served on it for nine years.
She took office in the Massachusetts House on January 7, 2015.
In August 2017 she changed her party affiliation from Republican to independent, saying she believed serving as an unenrolled member would help her work better with both Republicans and Democrats.
For 2025-2026 she serves on the Joint Committees on Aging and Independence, Higher Education, and Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery.
